title: HOPE: Heterophily-Aware Open-Set Node Classification with Pseudo-Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard open-set node classification methods rely on the homophily assumption, where connected nodes share labels. However, real-world graphs are often heterophilic, exposing the limitations of current methods and posing new challenges to open-set node classification. On the one hand, cross-class connectivity causes representations from different known or unknown classes to become intertwined after aggregation, undermining their discriminative capacity. On the other hand, structural mixture invalidates threshold-based open-set methods and cross-class feature interpolation, leading to unreliable unknown-class rejection. To address these challenges, we propose HOPE, a Heterophily-aware Open-set node classification method with Pseudo-Extrapolation. translated_title: HOPE：基于伪外推的异配感知开放集节点分类
translated_abstract: 标准的开放集节点分类方法依赖于同配性假设，即相连的节点共享相同的标签。然而，现实世界的图往往是异配的，这暴露了现有方法的局限性，并为开放集节点分类带来了新的挑战。一方面，跨类连接导致来自不同已知类或未知类的表示在聚合后相互纠缠，削弱了其判别能力。另一方面，结构混合使基于阈值的开放集方法和跨类特征插值失效，导致对未知类的拒识不可靠。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了HOPE，一种具有伪外推能力的异配感知开放集节点分类方法。为了使开放集图神经网络（GNN）适应异配场景，HOPE使用结构增强的特征初始化层来捕获多跳结构模式。同时，我们设……（摘要内容不完整）
